title: dbt & Modern Analytics Modeling
description: Learn how production analytics models are structured with dbt: staging, intermediate, and mart layers, when to materialise as a view vs table vs incremental model, how to handle late-arriving events and backfill requirements, and when a wide one-big-table beats a normalised star schema for BI tools and ML feature stores.
outcomes: You'll design a dbt project layer structure from staging through marts, choose between view, table, and incremental materializations based on query patterns and freshness requirements, select an incremental merge strategy for late-arriving event data with backfill constraints, and decide when a wide one-big-table outperforms a normalized star schema for BI tools or ML feature generation.
